Context: 7. Attachment for debt and maintenance

- (4) The net amount attachable = (x y) 1,000
- 3  
The total gross emoluments earned by the Government servant are represented by 'X', and the allowances declared to be exempt from attachment and, if the Government servant is under suspension, any subsistence grant or allowance made to him are represented by 'Y'.  
[ Rules 174 and 175, Postal FHB, Vol. I, Rule 2.4 (7) (f) of R & P Rules and Rules 225  
and 226 of CTR. ]
